request: How does successive halving decide which trials get more training?

composition.story: Successive halving allocates training budgets to competing trials. Each round promotes the top fraction, doubling their training resources until one victor remains.

aha.observation: Only the best performing trials from the previous round receive double resources.

states.why: Initial evaluation across the full candidate set.

states.label: Round 2
states.sentence: The top half of trials advance and receive double training resources.
states.why: Promoting leaders filters out poor configurations early.

states.label: Final
states.sentence: The single best performing trial receives maximum training resources.
states.why: Focuses remaining budget on the top performer.
